questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct?

options.text: Hand signals may only be used by motor vehicles.
Hand signals may not be used on freeways except for emergencies.
Hand signals are used by tractor driven drivers only.

questions.question: You may drive on the shoulder of the road left of the yellow edge line under certain circumstances. Which statement is incorrect?

options.text: On a single lane roadway between sunrise and sunset to allow other vehicles to overtake.
If it is safe to do so and visibility is good for 150 metres.
If it is safe to do so and visibility is good for 50 metres.

questions.question: What is the speed limit, unless otherwise indicated by a regulatory sign, for a minibus conveying passengers on a freeway?

options.text: 80 km/h
120 km/h
100 km/h

questions.question: Under which conditions will you be allowed to drive a motor vehicle on a public road once you have passed your learner's?

options.text: You must drive under the supervision of a person in possession of a valid driving licence for the same category vehicle that you will be driving.
The person should be seated behind you.
The person should be sitting in the boot.

questions.question: If you are a game ranger, are you allowed to have adjustable spot lamps fitted to your vehicle?

options.text: Yes.
No.
Yes, only under certain conditions.
You may straddle lane lines.
The general speed limit for a motor vehicle on a road in an urban area is 100 km/h.
You may not park on a traffic island.

questions.question: You may drive through an amber light if:

options.text: There is no time for an emergency stop.
There is no other traffic at the intersection.
Your vehicle is already over the stop line.

questions.question: Will the examiner fail you if you adjust your mirror while driving?

options.text: Yes, it could cause an accident.
No.
No, because you are not endangering other road users.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct?

options.text: You may use your phone while driving on the freeway.
You are not allowed to hold your cellphone while driving.
You may use your phone while driving in heavy traffic.

questions.question: A double white line separating the two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions means that:

options.text: You may cross to access property.
No traffic may cross the solid lines for any reason.
You may overtake if it is safe to do so.
